verses.1: Hear the words of the LORD, children of Israel! For the LORD is angry with the inhabitants of the earth. There is no truth, no mercy, and no wisdom from God in this world.
verses.2: They were murderers, thieves, and oppressors. They shed blood and caused destruction everywhere.
verses.3: Therefore, the earth will be desolate, and all those who live there will suffer in the wilderness and in the heavens. Even the fish in the sea will be destroyed.
verses.4: But no man shall be too proud or arrogant. Your people shall not be like those who are always quarreling with each other.
verses.5: And today, you failed. And also, the prophet who was with you that night failed as well. I became like your mother.
verses.6: My people seem to be deprived of knowledge. It seems that you have lost your wisdom and forgotten the laws of God. I too have forgotten them.
verses.7: In their arrogance, they sinned against me in their pride.
verses.8: The sins of my people will be eaten by birds, and their souls will be taken away.
verses.9: And it shall be that he will be like a priest. I will guide his ways and correct his mistakes. I will restore him to his rightful place.
verses.10: And they ate, but they did not rejoice. They did not also burst out in laughter, because they had abandoned Jehovah.
verses.11: Lust, greed, and selfishness will take away one’s heart.
verses.12: My people will ask, and their leaders will tell them that the spirits of the wicked have risen up and have been captured by their gods.
verses.13: On the tops of the mountains, they will be burned to ashes; on the slopes, they will be buried under snow and ice. For it is good to have such a covering over them. Thus, your children and offspring will be protected from harm.
verses.14: Do not treat your children badly, because they are still young. And do not treat your livestock badly, because they will be separated from their mothers. They will be sacrificed along with the sacred animals. And those who do not understand this will be punished.
verses.15: If you are Israel, then do not blame Judah. Do not let the curse come upon you, and do not enter the house of Aton. Do not dwell in it, for the Lord has said: “Do not enter there.”
verses.16: For Israel has sinned; they have acted wickedly. Now the LORD will rage against them, just as a fire rages in the wilderness.
verses.17: A group of sad people who are currently in a state of despair.
verses.18: Sir Sabam the Zaneh, they loved him. They were kind to him.
verses.19: The demon grabbed her with its wings and tried to devour them.
